description: Capture restart: the reliable control stream announces the end of instance 1 and the start of instance 2, then the first media datagram of instance 2 arrives with STREAM_START; the receiver resets playback and statistics state.
preconditions: A new instance id is generated on every capture reset/restart/process restart/discontinuous clock (§7.2); monotonic +1 per Server process, wrapping 2^32−1 -> 1.

steps.note: Fresh instance 2, generation 1, first frame at capture-clock 0.
First datagram of instance 2: sequence 0, timestamp 0, STREAM_START.

assertions: The new instance BEGINS A NEW RECEIVER EPOCH: playback position, dedup window, jitter estimate and all §9 counters reset (§7.5); instance 1's statistics are finalized by the Client.
STREAM_START confirms the 0 origin; the reliable StreamStarted push carries the anchor, so loss cannot remove it while the connection lives (§7.5).
Old instance datagrams arriving after the switch (stragglers) are dropped against the new epoch (§7.5).
Sequence restarts at 0 for the new instance — a sequence reset is only legal alongside a new instance id.
